fact: Prime Minister's Decision No. 1568 of 2026 (21 May 2026) issued the executive regulations of Asylum Law No. 164 of 2024, under which a state committee issues asylum-seeker registration cards and UNHCR cards stay valid until expiry or replacement.
title: قرار مجلس الوزراء رقم 1568 لسنة 2026 بإصدار اللائحة التنفيذية لقانون لجوء الأجانب
